Title: General availability: Troubleshooting guides for Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server

Body.Content:
The new troubleshooting guides empower you to analyze and troubleshoot common performance issues in your Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server environment. These issues include high CPU usage, high memory consumption, high IOPS consumption, high usage of temporary files, autovacuum disturbances, and blockers. Each guide provides you with multiple charts, guidelines, and aggregated information about specific problems you may encounter, accelerating the troubleshooting process. 

Learn more.
